title: PLA2G2D in tumour-draining lymph nodes regulates anti-tumour immunity.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: GSE282437 (human): downloaded SampleInfo.txt.gz and counts_Q3norm.txt.gz. 61 regions of interest (GeoMx targeted spatial transcriptomics, CD68/CD8a/CD11c-masked) from 10 patients, 5 disease-free (DF) and 5 relapsed (R), about 8,860 genes. GSE333464 (mouse): downloaded the scRNA-seq metadata CSV, 43,123 cells across 48 samples (4 replicates each of untreated, IFN-gamma, anti-PD-1 and anti-PLA2G2D arms, by tissue: lymph node, TDLN (tumour-draining lymph node), tumour). Raw counts CSV (126 MB) and RDS (1.2 GB) were not downloaded because of size.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: The imaging mass cytometry cohort, the metastasis link and the mechanism come from the abstract only (no open-access full text, no PMCID, no supplement retrievable). The imaging mass cytometry data was not found in GEO or any repository link. GEO lists 69 human samples, but the processed file has 61 columns.

a1_downloadable.note: Both GEO series download openly (checked). The imaging mass cytometry images were not found in any repository.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: The patient outcome (DF vs R) is a column in SampleInfo.txt (checked). Mouse treatment and tissue are columns in the cell metadata (checked).

a3_inputs_present.note: Normalised gene counts are present for the human regions (checked). Mouse raw counts exist as a 126 MB CSV (seen in the file listing, not opened).

a4_units_stated.note: Q3-normalised counts (scaled to the upper quartile, the standard GeoMx normalisation) plus raw counts; the units are implied by the file names.

a5_enough_rows.note: The clinically meaningful label (recurrence) is per patient: 10 patients, 5 per class, measured in 61 regions (checked). The mouse treatment label covers 48 samples, 4 per arm and tissue. Both are far under 400.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: ~2 MB human; ~126 MB mouse raw CSV

a7_counts_match_paper.note: GEO lists 69 human samples, but the Q3 and SampleInfo files hold 61 regions. The gap is unexplained without the full text.

a8_label_provenance.note: The mouse cell-type labels are Seurat cluster annotations computed from the same expression data, so they are circular. Patient outcome is a genuine clinical measurement, but there are only 10 patients.

backbone.name: scGPT / Geneformer (single-cell) could embed the mouse cells, but no valid label exists

honest_claim_h3: With 10 patients, any model could only claim to separate these 5 relapsed from these 5 disease-free melanoma patients by lymph-node region expression, which is not generalisable.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use gene expression in lymph-node regions near melanoma to predict whether the patient's cancer later returns.
plain_idea.train_on: Normalised expression of about 8,860 genes in 61 lymph-node regions from 10 patients (verified).
plain_idea.predict: Whether the patient relapsed within 2 years or stayed disease-free for over 5 years, taken from clinical follow-up.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: A lymph-node relapse predictor would help oncologists decide how aggressively to treat, but 10 patients cannot support one.

label_elsewhere.sources: Not searched; the project was rejected at Part A.

ml_idea: Patient-level relapse classification from GeoMx (targeted spatial transcriptomics) lymph-node regions, or treatment-arm classification from mouse single-cell data. Neither has enough independent units.

effort.compute_note: Estimated from file sizes; nothing was timed.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count the patients per outcome in SampleInfo.txt: 5 DF vs 5 R (done; it kills the project).

verdict_reason: A5: the only real label (recurrence) covers 10 patients, and the mouse treatment arms have 4 replicates each. The mouse cell types are clustering output (A8), and the human sample count differs between GEO and the files (69 vs 61). Existing models were not searched, because the project failed at Part A.
